=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: The PR description's CONCERN finding states that "§26.I lists the `/implement-plan-claude` cleanup sites, and the command's Rules bullet lists the same ones. Both leave out two sites that run on every stage" — the step 2 stale-Routine delete (`.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:20`) and the `set_session_title` rename when a stage opens a PR (Session titles, `:142`). The issue's acceptance criterion requires that no flow retries a denied cleanup call, so both lists have to enumerate these sites.
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` (Rules bullet at `:422`) and its template twin `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md`, plus a test assertion that the Rules bullet enumerates these sites.
  Evidence of absence: The PR DIFF (LAST RUN DIFF and ORIGINAL PR DIFF) does not touch either `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` or `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md`. AD-11 in the progress log explicitly chose Option A (CLAUDE.md §26.I only) over Option B (also update the command twin) and the auto-decision rationale is that "the rename site already says a failed rename never blocks the stage" — but that argument does not satisfy the original finding, which says a stage that applies §26.I to the Rules bullet's narrower list can still retry a denied delete or rename at these two. The new test `test_claude_md_26i_covers_the_per_stage_delete_and_rename` only asserts that §26.I contains the new phrases and that the call sites still exist in the twin; it does NOT assert that the Rules bullet at `:422` enumerates these sites. The Copilot inline review comment (entry `[0]`, id 4151166112) raised exactly this same concern and was not addressed before the conformance-fix commit landed. The PR description's "Not fixed (needs a decision or out of reach)" section is empty, so this gap is not an explicit deferral.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- Requirement: The PR description states "§26.I lists the `/implement-plan-claude` cleanup sites, and the command's Rules bullet lists the same ones. Both leave out two sites that run on every stage: the step 2 delete of stale `implement-plan <slug>` Routines from the previous design (`.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:20`), and the `set_session_title` rename when a stage opens a PR (Session titles, `:142`; steps 3a, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12)."
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` Rules section and its template twin `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md`
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff updates CLAUDE.md §26.I to include both missing sites, but does not touch `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` or its template twin. The Copilot review comment (entry[0].id: 4151166112) at CLAUDE.md:2195 explicitly states "The command's own Rules bullet is still stale: `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:422` (and its template twin) enumerates cleanup sites but omits both the step 2 stale-Routine delete and the PR-opening rename. Because that runtime instruction still presents a narrower list, adding the sites only to §26.I does not fully resolve the conformance finding and can still lead a stage to treat these calls differently." The command file is what sessions actually read and follow at runtime, so if it enumerates fewer sites than §26.I, a session following the command file might still retry denied cleanup calls at the omitted sites. The PR description's own finding identifies this as the defect, and the fix should address both locations.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
